usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.skills.versions.list("skill_123", limit: 1, order: "asc", after: "skillver_123")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.skills.versions.list(skill_id, limit: nil, order: nil, after: nil) -> Page<Models::SkillVersionResource>

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order of results by version number.

fields.name: after
fields.description: The skill version ID to start after.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the skill version.

fields.name: skill_id
fields.description: Identifier of the skill for this version.
